mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, quantity FROM test_cart WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, quantity FROM test_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dish_id = #{dishId}

SELECT c.id, c.dish_id, c.quantity, d.name AS dish_name, d.image_url AS dish_image, d.price, d.stock, d.status AS dish_status FROM test_cart c JOIN dish d ON d.id = c.dish_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id ASC
SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, quantity FROM test_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_cart (user_id, dish_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
